samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: Your friend Alex wants to know about an online study workshop. Write an email describing the activity, explaining the arrangements, and offering practical advice.
requirementsVi: Giới thiệu hoạt động và lợi ích.

samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. You asked about an online study workshop, so I am happy to share the details. I thought of you when I saw the programme because you enjoy learning useful things with other people.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cảm ơn, nhắc đúng câu hỏi của bạn.

paragraphs.label: Hoạt động
paragraphs.text: We will try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. The aim is to connect the topic with everyday life rather than only listen to a long talk. One useful point is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift.
paragraphs.noteVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Sắp xếp và gợi ý
paragraphs.text: The session is at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. Please bring headphones and arrive about ten minutes early. If you want to prepare, think of one question about online university classes. We can compare our notes afterwards and decide which ideas would be useful in our own lives.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời đủ thời gian, địa điểm, chuẩn bị.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
